stories.title: El magistrado de las cloacas del PSOE cita a la jueza que investigó al hermano de Sánchez

en.title: Judge investigating alleged PSOE illegal operations summons judge who investigated Sánchez's brother
en.summary: A National Court judge has admitted a Badajoz judge as a victim in the investigation into alleged illegal PSOE operations and has summoned her to testify on October 8. The Badajoz judge had previously investigated the president's brother.

stories.title: El Gobierno aprobará antes de fin de año un decreto contra la privada que acaba con la FP online

en.title: Government to approve decree against private education ending online vocational training before year-end
en.summary: The government plans to pass a decree before the end of the year targeting private educational institutions, requiring greater in-person instruction and mandating that certain degree programs have 50% doctoral-level faculty. This continues the administration's regulatory efforts against private education.

stories.title: Los detalles del decreto ley de Moncloa sobre vivienda con el que quieren convencer a sus socios

en.title: Details of Moncloa housing decree aimed at convincing coalition partners
en.summary: The Cabinet is set to approve a housing decree on Tuesday intended to address the housing emergency and secure support from parliamentary partners including Junts and Podemos. The measure requires congressional validation and aims to persuade coalition members.

stories.title: La acampada en la Puerta del Sol en Madrid y la última hora sobre Maricarmen y el decreto de la vivienda, hoy en directo

en.title: Encampment at Madrid's Puerta del Sol and latest updates on Maricarmen and housing decree, live today
en.summary: Approximately 600 people remain camped at Madrid's Puerta del Sol protesting the housing situation, having spent the night without incidents. The protest continues amid housing crisis concerns.

stories.title: La Audiencia Nacional admite como víctima en el ‘caso Leire Díez’ a la jueza que investigó al hermano de Sánchez

en.title: The National Court accepts as a victim in the 'Leire Díez case' the judge who investigated Sánchez's brother
en.summary: A magistrate at Spain's National Court has recognized a judge as a victim in a legal case and has summoned her to testify regarding alleged defamation offenses.

stories.title: Robles pide "máxima sinceridad" al nuevo delegado del Gobierno en Ceuta y pone en duda la "transparencia" del saliente

en.title: Robles calls for "maximum honesty" from the new Government delegate in Ceuta and questions the "transparency" of the outgoing official
en.summary: Spain's Defense Minister has questioned the outgoing government delegate's transparency in Ceuta and requested maximum honesty from the incoming replacement.

stories.title: Sumar y el resto de la izquierda parlamentaria unen sus fuerzas para presionar al PSOE en el decreto de vivienda

en.title: Sumar and the rest of the parliamentary left unite forces to pressure the PSOE on the housing decree
en.summary: Left-wing parties in Parliament are coordinating to apply pressure on the PSOE regarding negotiations over housing policy measures.

stories.title: Pedraz admite la personación de la juez que investigó a David Sánchez como perjudicada en el 'caso Leire' y la cita a declarar el 8 de octubre

en.title: Pedraz admits the appearance of the judge who investigated David Sánchez as a victim in the 'Leire case' and summons her to testify on October 8
en.summary: A judge at Spain's National Court has recognized a magistrate as a victim of defamation in a legal case and summoned her to testify in October.

stories.title: Así es el decreto contra los chiringuitos privados de FP: los títulos online tendrán un máximo de 50 alumnos por profesor

en.title: This is the decree against private vocational training centers: online degrees will have a maximum of 50 students per teacher
en.summary: A new decree sets limits for distance learning in vocational education, requiring between 15% and 39% in-person instruction depending on the course type, with a maximum of 50 students per teacher in online programs.

stories.title: Desahucios, fondos buitre y bonificaciones: las medidas con las que Moncloa busca convencer a todos sus socios para apoyar el decreto sobre vivienda

en.title: Evictions, vulture funds and bonuses: the measures with which Moncloa seeks to convince all its allies to support the housing decree
en.summary: The government negotiates urgently to gain support from ideologically diverse political groups for housing legislation. The effort involves coordinating positions among left-wing and right-wing parties with conflicting priorities.

stories.title: El delegado del Gobierno en Ceuta deja la política: “Mi familia no merece que yo siga”

en.title: The Government's delegate in Ceuta leaves politics: "My family doesn't deserve this to continue"
en.summary: The Government's delegate in Ceuta, Miguel Ángel Pérez Triano, is stepping down from politics after reporting a harassment campaign involving insults and threats, stating he had warned the Executive weeks prior.

stories.title: El delegado en Ceuta solicitó al Gobierno refuerzos ante el agravamiento de la presión migratoria una semana antes de la avalancha

en.title: Ceuta delegate requested Government reinforcements before migration pressure worsened a week before the surge
en.summary: Socialist Party members in Ceuta sought assistance from the Government starting July 28, reporting that the migrant situation was unsustainable and overwhelming.

stories.title: Cuerpo: "El sector financiero es un actor relevante para afrontar el acceso a la vivienda"

en.title: Cuerpo: "The financial sector is a relevant actor to address housing access"
en.summary: The Economy Minister identifies the financial sector as essential for addressing pending challenges including housing access, EU transformation, and artificial intelligence integration in the financial sector.

stories.title: El Ibex cae a los 19.600 puntos con el petróleo otra vez en 107 dólares

en.title: The Ibex falls to 19,600 points with oil back at 107 dollars
en.summary: The Ibex 35 drops to 19,600 points as oil returns to 107 dollars, pressured by weakness in Asia and the US linked to artificial intelligence concerns and geopolitical tensions over Iran.

stories.title: Lagarde pide a la UE un despliegue intensivo de la Inteligencia Artificial

en.title: Lagarde calls on the EU for intensive deployment of Artificial Intelligence
en.summary: The ECB president believes Europe can create conditions for technological advancement to boost productivity and living standards. She confirmed the central bank will continue raising interest rates gradually without abrupt moves.

stories.title: La IA en la banca mediana: cómo innovar sin perder la esencia

en.title: AI in mid-sized banking: how to innovate without losing essence
en.summary: Executives from Kutxabank, Ibercaja, and Banca March highlight the value of personalized service amid risks of financial product standardization. They view AI as a tool to strengthen their identity as customer-focused, less complex institutions.

stories.title: Las imágenes del XVII Encuentro Financiero EXPANSIÓN-KPMG

en.title: Images from the XVII EXPANSIÓN-KPMG Financial Meeting
en.summary: Leaders from major banks and insurance companies gathered with supervisors and regulators at the EXPANSIÓN-KPMG Financial Meeting to discuss economic and financial challenges.
